operation.summary: How long API calls take on this device, from receiving the request to sending the response: count, median, p95 and max per API, and the slow calls with the device context they ran in (network, battery, thermal, app build, screen, load). Every transport: HTTP, MCP, relay, cards, schedules and the control server. Kept in memory: the newest 5000 calls, at most 7 days, empty after a restart. Calls you may see follow the log's visibility

query.name: api
query.description: Only this API: its operation name as in openapi.json (e.g. getHealth), or tool <name> / <METHOD> <path> for the control server

query.name: slow_ms
query.description: A call this slow or slower counts as slow, 1-600000, default 1000

query.name: limit
query.description: Slow calls to return, newest first, 0-200, default 50

query.name: minutes
query.description: Only calls from the last 1-10080 minutes; default every kept call

operation.returns: device {name (the Device Domain Name, or null before one is registered), magic_dns}, kept {calls, capacity, max_age_hours, oldest, since_restart}, in_flight, slow_ms, apis[api, method, path, count, errors, median_ms, p95_ms, max_ms, slow] (slowest p95 first), slow_calls[ts, api, method, path, via, request_id, agent, agent_id, duration_ms, outcome (success or error), http, result, bytes_in, bytes_out (0 where not counted), in_flight (calls running when it arrived, itself included), ran_on, context], context_now. context: network {type wifi/cellular/ethernet/other/none, metered}, battery {percent, charging, power_save}, thermal, app {version, build, commit}, screen {on, locked}, listener_ready; sampled at most every 10 s. No parameters, bodies, addresses, location or sensor data
